posts.title: Simply TBR 1.5.0: Find It, Then Make It Yours
posts.description: Scan or type in a book and you can now use Find It to look it up at Libby, Bookshop, and the other places you already use. It’s free for everyone. Plus Not Mine Yet, a new source for books you’d love to read but don’t have yet... not quite a wishlist.
